For placement of order, the OEM [Principal Firm] directly or through authorized dealers shall have succe ssfully executed a contract for supply of Hand Carried Stretcher to any Govt organization/PSU/PPP Project of minimum 10 percent of the advertised value of the bid [Bid Value – 216150.00] during previous 3 years.
